answer: Deposits are visible in onyx, and vine reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 34% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 178 aliases, and each one needs its own funded ledge account. A farm of 4300 identities would post 2207 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
